# 分配到客服

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /openapi/ipcc/calltask/add:
    post:
      summary: 分配到客服
      deprecated: false
      description: 指定分配到客服，即seatType=0时
      tags:
        - 呼叫系统/外呼任务/创建外呼任务
      parameters:
        - name: appKey
          in: query
          description: 企业的appKey，0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
          required: true
          example: '{{appKey}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: time
          in: query
          description: 当前 UTC 时间戳，从 1970 年 1 月 1 日 0 点 0 分 0 秒开始到现在的秒数,1463217187
          required: true
          example: '{{time}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: checksum
          in: query
          description: >-
            SHA1(appSecret + md5 + time),
            三个参数拼接的字符串，进行SHA1哈希计算，转化成16进制字符(String，小写).示例2f13932c4b7c6888b12360a85261a11b8b543f64 
          required: true
          example: '{{checksum}} '
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: content-type
          in: header
          description: ''
          required: true
          example: application/json;charset=utf-8
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                  description: 任务名称
                description:
                  type: string
                  description: 任务描述
                startTime:
                  type: integer
                  description: 任务绝对开始时间，单位为毫秒
                endTime:
                  type: integer
                  description: 任务绝对结束时间，单位为毫秒
                seatType:
                  type: integer
                  description: 指定客服类型，0-客服，1-客服分组，2-按客户关系分配 3-按自定义客户分配
                seatIds:
                  type: string
                  description: >-
                    客服的id串或者客服组id串，以逗号分隔，当seatType=0时，代表客服的id，当seatType=1时，代表客服组的id
                customerInfo:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      name:
                        type: string
                        description: 用户名
                      value:
                        type: string
                        description: 用户手机号
                      remarks:
                        type: string
                        description: 客户负责人staffId
                  description: 用户号码信息键值对，为Json数组
              required:
                - name
            example:
              name: 意向客户回访
              description: 新注册用户回访
              startTime: 1517722346089
              endTime: 1517808746089
              seatType: 0
              seatIds: 40004,40005
              customerInfo:
                - name: 阿波罗
                  value: '18957128912'
                  remarks: ''
                - name: 小喽喽
                  value: '15411660066'
                  remarks: ''
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                    description: 错误码
                  message:
                    type: string
                    description: 错误描述
                required:
                  - code
                  - message
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 呼叫系统/外呼任务/创建外呼任务
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/605287/apis/api-10845503-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: http://qiyukf.com
    description: 正式环境
security: []

```
